indexedFixtureFamilies.empty: No indexed records; independent normalization/copy fixtures still exercise their own inputs.
indexedFixtureFamilies.dense: All 19 ranks and 3 cutoffs across 3 adjacent month-end days, plus 4 reviewed archive rows.
indexedFixtureFamilies.sparse: Nine widely separated dates, partial ranks/cutoffs and some same-day records, plus 4 reviewed archive rows.

scope.numericGeneration: Two 32-bit PRNG outputs are combined via BigInt into 53 bits. Numeric-format scenarios guarantee low, middle stored-value, high 53-bit, boundary and invalid bands.

limitations: Synthetic conditions, not actual people or distinct implemented improvements.
Finite boundary values legitimately recur; each round uses a different PRNG seed and varies combined conditions and record values.
No DOM, real browser, iPhone, touch, keyboard, network or production data checks are counted here.
UI event and layout tests and the final ten debug rounds are separate.
